blocking_findings.detail: The harness resolves the canonical data root to /Users/adpena/Projects/pact and requires a claim ledger there plus operator authorization under that root. The delegated worktree contract forbids touching MAIN. A shadow worktree root would not be canonical and was not fabricated.

Even after a valid authority wrapper, measure marks path_split_status=BLOCKED_EXACT_SKIP_DEEP_HOOK and resize_split_status=BLOCKED_FULL_ORTHOGONAL_RANGE_KERNEL_INTERVENTION, sets finding_eligible=false, and unconditionally refuses after full-path geometry.

The predecessor receipt expires after one hour, while the immutable run_contract embeds the claim-receipt path and SHA. Refreshing the lease changes that SHA; retaining it fails freshness. Thus a long n600 run cannot satisfy both renewable execution authority and byte-identical resume custody.
No Seg, Pose, or counted-rate R-D points were produced on one receiver-closed artifact, so neither marginal equality nor an implied minimum score is identifiable.

The real measurement chain imports SegNet only. admit-rd is explicitly d_seg-component authority, no PoseNet marginal is measured, no candidate archive generator exists, and no three-axis KKT solver is implemented.
